title: The Social Serendipity of Cloud Gaming

reader_summary.headline: Hi and welcome with the A16D podcast.
reader_summary.overview: Hi and welcome with the A16D podcast. True cloud native games, those exclusive to and solely playable within the cloud. It's a vision that, though steadily advancing, is still in its early stages. Just one year ago this week, Google launched its cloud gaming service, Stadia, which shares the space with competitors, including Microsoft's XCloud, PlayStation Now.

thesis: The episode argues that true cloud-native games represent a second wave of development where games are built from the ground up for cloud infrastructure rather than being ported from existing hardware. This paradigm shift enables new mechanics, such as infinite player connections and live audience inputs that directly alter the game simulation, moving beyond current limitations of local processing power and network ping.
